key_insight: KOAL improves prostate cancer Gleason Grade Group prediction by combining MRI with clinical context and expert knowledge while modeling the ordinal structure of tumor grading.
clinical_relevance: This approach may help better stratify prostate cancer risk from non-invasive mpMRI, potentially reducing unnecessary biopsies and improving treatment decision support.
method: Clinical-Context Modulation uses age and PSA to adapt image features.
Knowledge-Guided Prototype Alignment turns radiology reports and guidelines into offline semantic anchors for contrastive learning.
Hierarchical Ordinal-aware Constraints separately predict primary and secondary Gleason patterns and map them to GGG with a differentiable biologic layer.
evidence_signal: The authors report that KOAL outperformed state-of-the-art methods on the public PI-CAI dataset and an in-house dataset.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and generalizability of extracted expert knowledge and multi-site MRI data, so external validation and deployment calibration are important.
paper_title: KOAL: Knowledge-Driven Prostate Cancer Grading with Ordinal-Aware Learning
